title: 轻松收尾
description: 成人完成短练后坐在垫区外换鞋，同伴在旁整理毛巾。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult finishes a modest practice session by sitting on a bench outside the landing area and changing from climbing shoes into trainers. A companion folds a towel nearby, while the low wall behind them is empty and softly lit. Show relaxed shoulders, calm faces, and a tidy gear bag rather than fatigue or celebration of difficulty. The landscape composition centers the quiet decision to stop comfortably, with a clear gap between seating and mats. Use quilted textile illustration with stitched fabric shapes, readable adult anatomy, felt-like mat surfaces, and a calm blue and sand palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
